title: Why Does The Same Temptation Keep Finding You? | Your Struggle And What God Made You For
description:
Why does the same temptation keep finding you? What the Bible says about your struggle and what God made you for.

Smoking, self-doubt, distraction, the fear that people leave. This goes through each one with Scripture: Satan asked for Peter by name, and in the same breath Jesus told Peter what he was for. You do have an enemy, and you are still tempted by your own lust, so nobody gets to say the devil made me do it. It ends with the way of escape and a prayer. The idea came from a Short by Monopoly Ace; every point here is checked against the Bible.

"There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it." 1 Corinthians 10:13 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Luke 22:31-32, 1 Peter 5:8, James 1:14, 1 Corinthians 6:19, Psalm 150:6, Exodus 4:11-12, 2 Corinthians 12:9, Nehemiah 6:3, Ephesians 5:15-16, Psalm 27:10, 1 Samuel 22:2, John 6:37, 2 Corinthians 1:4, 1 Corinthians 10:13, James 4:7, Hebrews 7:25.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
